question: In the SAA investment manager questionnaire for fixed income investment management services, which services is the firm asked to indicate whether it offers, along with any additional fee?
expected_facts: Five services: Schedule D investment accounting; asset/liability management (dynamic financial analysis); performance attribution; daily internet access of portfolio information; and SVO filing. For each, the firm marks Yes/No and gives an approximate fee.
acceptance: Require all five services; Yes/No and approximate fee wording are useful context, not additional services.
